body:
Adds `research/shutter-twin` (pure Python, 8 tests): a global-shutter twin of a rolling-shutter camera ignores target motion. Closed-form edge normals for a moving rectangle match a row-by-row simulation; a twin-trained orientation estimate is biased by half the vertical-edge tilt; one frame of a known-size target identifies pose and velocity. Stylised, no real footage; size sensitivity reported as a limitation.

Also updates the README bullet and `site/projects.json`; `python site/build.py` prints ok (180 projects).
